payload.title: Review the repository and summarize the Stage 0 deferred issues. Do not modify any files.

outOfScope: any change to packages/server/** — this task is read-only summarization
fixing the credit-note edit inventory rewrite (TASK-0000 seq 32 defers it to Stage 1; TASK-0001 already owns it and is ESCALATED)
changing the upstream credit-note edit payload (openedAt / refundedAmount / invoicesAmount, upstream 76fc32078) — that alters edit semantics
reconstructing the missing Codex design-review transcript (TASK-0000 seq 3 declares it unrecoverable; inventing it would corrupt the event log)
computing reviewer miss rate or finding precision (TASK-0000 seq 33: denominators are structurally unrecoverable)
re-running or re-verifying the Stage 0 test suite
installing the Codex CLI or setting AI_CODEX_BIN to unblock TASK-0001

the 13 items already declared out of scope by the Stage 0 design: tax correctness, FX/exchange-rate correctness, document totals, overapplication rules, period locking, READ_UNCOMMITTED isolation, assertBalanced(), retries/backoff, async COGS worker, pre-COMMIT enqueue, EE/ee packaging, SMTP and invites, NaN route params
invariants: The working tree content is byte-identical before and after this task, excluding .ai/ orchestrator bookkeeping (which git-manager.ts excludes from the change set as of 91b5107d5).
Every deferred item reported is traceable to a stored DEFERRED, BACKFILL_GAP, or RUNTIME_EVIDENCE.notVerified record in .ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl — no item is inferred from code reading alone.

A deferral is reported as deferred, not as fixed and not as absent: the Stage 0 record distinguishes 1 DEFERRED item, 2 BACKFILL_GAPs, and 4 notVerified items, and the summary preserves that partition.
Absence of evidence stays visible: items the Stage 0 record marks unrecoverable are reported as unrecoverable rather than silently dropped or estimated.
The summary states the deferral reason as recorded (why it is Stage 1 work), not a re-derived rationale.
falsifiablePredictions: `git stash list` is unchanged and `git diff HEAD --` over all paths outside .ai/ produces empty output at task end. Any non-empty diff falsifies the read-only claim.

Content-level check (per DRV-001 adjudicated PARTIAL on TASK-0003): `git diff HEAD --stat -- ':!.ai'` and a pre/post `git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}` comparison must both show no change. Path-status-only checks such as `git status --porcelain` are insufficient because they report status codes, not content, and would not detect a same-path content rewrite.
The deferred-item count reported equals exactly 1 (credit-note edit inventory rewrite). If the event log yields a different count of DEFERRED events for TASK-0000, this summary is wrong.
`grep -c '"type":"BACKFILL_GAP"' .ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl` returns 2. A different number falsifies the gap inventory.

The credit-note onEdited short-circuit is pinned, not fixed: packages/server/test/stage0-final-atomicity.stage0-spec.ts asserts `openedAt` is null and `isOpen` is false on edit. If that test instead asserts the inventory rewrite executes, the item was fixed and the deferral report is stale.

TASK-0001 (the Stage 1 successor for this deferral) is in state ESCALATED with lastError naming reviewer unavailability. If TASK-0001 is READY_TO_MERGE, the deferral has been closed and this summary is out of date.
implementationConstraints: Read-only: no Write, Edit, or file-creating Bash. Zero production code, zero test code, zero doc changes.

Empty scopeAllowlist is intentional and now policy-safe: 91b5107d5 excludes .ai/ from the change set, so the SCOPE_ALLOWLIST_EMPTY block that escalated TASK-0003 does not apply to a genuinely zero-file task.

requiredTests: None. This task adds no behaviour, so a new test would assert nothing. Adding one would violate the read-only invariant.

requiredRuntimeAcceptance: Content-level no-op proof: capture `git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}` and `git diff HEAD --` (excluding .ai/) before and after; both must be identical/empty. This is the DRV-001-hardened form — path-status output alone is not accepted.
Untracked-file check: no new untracked paths outside .ai/tasks/TASK-0004/.
Event-log integrity: .ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl is append-only and unmodified — its 35 events and their eventIds are unchanged.

Provenance spot-check: each reported item resolves to a concrete event — DEFERRED at seq 32 (EV-e174e65a8593d391), BACKFILL_GAP at seq 3 (EV-c6e945908dc32a4a) and seq 33 (EV-5fe39a3dfaf562b2), and the four notVerified entries inside RUNTIME_EVIDENCE at seq 31.
No test run is required or performed; asserting a green suite without executing it would be fabricated evidence.
knownUnverified: SUBSTANTIVE DEFERRAL (1, the only DEFERRED event in Stage 0): credit-note edit inventory rewrite. The onEdited handler is invoked on a real API edit but always returns early at `if (!creditNote.isOpen) return;`. isOpen = !!openedAt && creditsRemaining > 0; upsertGraph omits openedAt when the note was already open, and omits refundedAmount/invoicesAmount on every edit (upstream 76fc32078), so creditsRemaining is NaN and isOpen is false in both edit branches. Proven unreachable and pinned by test — NOT fixed. Deferred because a fix changes edit semantics, which is Stage 1 work. Successor TASK-0001 exists and is ESCALATED (no `codex` executable on the host or in the bc-node container; reviewer-provider independence is a hard policy).

EVIDENCE GAP 1 (unrecoverable): the Codex design-review transcript for Stage 0. Stage 0 predates the observatory; reviews were relayed as human prose and the verbatim reviewer output was never captured. Cannot be reconstructed without inventing it.

EVIDENCE GAP 2 (structurally unrecoverable): reviewer miss rate and finding-precision denominators. Only raised findings leave a trace; issues nobody raised leave none, so precision and recall cannot be computed from Stage 0 at all.

NOT VERIFIED by Stage 0 acceptance (4 recorded): numeric tax / FX / rounding correctness; historical production data; asynchronous COGS worker behaviour; the credit-note edit inventory rewrite itself.
All 35 Stage 0 events are reconstructed (26 HIGH, 9 MEDIUM confidence), not natively captured — the deferral and both gaps are HIGH, but no Stage 0 event is primary-source.

The four CDX-S0-0x blockers were all adjudicated CONFIRMED and fixed (ledger async.queue drain, UnitOfWork manual transaction, financial reversals outside owning transaction, payment-received A/R creation) — these are closed, not deferred, and are listed here only to bound what 'deferred' excludes.
Whether the Stage 0 out-of-scope list is complete for Stage 1 planning purposes is unverified — it records what Stage 0 declined to touch, not everything that may be wrong.

This summary was produced without running the Stage 0 suite; the '29 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped' and 'Stage -1: 55 clean' figures are quoted from the recorded RUNTIME_EVIDENCE event, not independently reproduced in this task.

findings.claim: The proposed no-op proof cannot establish that working-tree content is byte-identical before and after the task. `git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}` examines the committed tree and is unaffected by working-tree edits, while requiring only an empty final `git diff HEAD` does not preserve pre-existing tracked modifications.
findings.scenario: Before the task, `packages/server/example.ts` contains an uncommitted user change. During the task it is accidentally overwritten with the HEAD version. At task end, `HEAD^{tree}` is unchanged, `git diff HEAD -- ':!.ai'` is empty, and there are no new untracked files, so every proposed acceptance check passes even though the user's original bytes were lost.
findings.violatedInvariant: The working tree content is byte-identical before and after this task, excluding .ai/ orchestrator bookkeeping.
findings.evidenceAvailable: The commands and invariant stated in the design are sufficient to demonstrate the gap. Missing evidence: no pre-task content snapshot or digest covering tracked and untracked paths is specified. The repository could not be inspected because the execution sandbox failed during read-only command startup.

payload.reasoning: The mechanism half of the claim is correct and I can tie it to the invariant. `git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}` resolves the tree object of the HEAD commit; it is computed from committed state alone and is insensitive to every working-tree and index edit. It changes only if a new commit is created. The design promotes it as the 'DRV-001-hardened, content-level' evidence for a working-tree byte-identity invariant, and that is a category error: it can prove 'no commit was made' and nothing else. Confirmed on that point. A second real gap the finding gestures at but does not name: the acceptance checks only for NEW untracked paths outside .ai/tasks/TASK-0004/, so overwriting or deleting a PRE-EXISTING untracked non-ignored file passes every stated check. That is a genuine hole in the same invariant. The claim overstates in two ways. First, it asserts the design requires 'only an empty final git diff HEAD'. It does not: requiredRuntimeAcceptance says capture `git diff HEAD --` (excluding .ai/) 'before and after; both must be identical/empty'. Under the before-and-after comparison the finding's own scenario is caught — a pre-existing uncommitted change to packages/server/example.ts yields a non-empty before-diff and an empty after-diff, which are not identical, so the check fails and the loss is detected. The scenario only defeats the design under a reading that discards the pre-task capture the design explicitly mandates. Second, runtime evidence outranks the hypothetical: I inspected the repository the reviewer could not. `git status --porcelain` reports exactly one entry, `?? .ai/tasks/TASK-0004/`; `git diff HEAD --name-only` over ALL paths is empty; `git stash list` is empty; `git ls-files -o --exclude-standard -- ':!.ai'` returns nothing; HEAD^{tree} is 3ab8a2e2ecaa6986162d729c010bf7377f9b53b2. There are no pre-existing tracked modifications and no pre-existing untracked non-.ai files, so the described data-loss path has no instance in this task's actual starting state. The finding is therefore hardening of an inert proof step, not a live violation. Severity BLOCKER is not sustained; this is a correctness defect in the evidence procedure at roughly MINOR severity for TASK-0004 as it actually stands, and worth fixing because the procedure is being carried forward as a reusable no-op proof for later read-only tasks where the tree may not be clean.
payload.requiredFix: Amend DESIGN.requiredRuntimeAcceptance, three edits, no change to the invariants or to scope. (1) Demote `git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}` from 'content-level proof' to what it actually establishes: 'HEAD is unchanged — no commit was created during the task.' Keep it; stop citing it as evidence for working-tree content. (2) Add a real working-tree content digest covering tracked AND untracked non-ignored paths outside .ai/, captured before the task and again after, with the two values required to be identical: `git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -- ':!.ai' | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum | sha256sum`. This is sensitive to same-path content rewrites, to reverted pre-existing modifications, and to deletions (a deleted tracked file makes sha256sum error and the digest diverge). (3) Replace 'no NEW untracked paths outside .ai/tasks/TASK-0004/' with 'the set of untracked non-ignored paths outside .ai/ is unchanged, and their contents are covered by the digest in (2)'. Retain the existing before/after `git diff HEAD -- ':!.ai'` and `git stash list` checks unchanged — they are sound as written and are what already defeats the finding's scenario. Also state explicitly what the design currently leaves ambiguous: if the pre-task digest or pre-task diff shows a dirty tree outside .ai/, the task records that baseline rather than treating cleanliness as a precondition, so byte-identity is proven against the real starting state and not against HEAD.
payload.requiredEvidence: The fix is proven when the TASK-0004 record contains, verbatim: (a) the pre-task and post-task digest values from the `git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -- ':!.ai' | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum` command, and they are byte-identical; (b) pre-task and post-task `git diff HEAD -- ':!.ai'` output, both empty, matching the empty result already observed at task start; (c) pre-task and post-task `git ls-files -o --exclude-standard -- ':!.ai'` output, both empty; (d) pre-task and post-task `git stash list`, both empty; (e) `git rev-parse HEAD` unchanged, labelled as the no-new-commit check rather than as content evidence. Negative control that would falsify the fix: writing one byte to any tracked file outside .ai/ and re-running the digest must produce a different value; if the digest is unchanged under that mutation, the proof is still inert and the finding escalates to CONFIRMED at its original severity.

payload.reason: Read-only summarization of Stage 0 deferred issues. No file was written, edited, or created. STAGE 0 DEFERRED-ITEM RECORD (.ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl, 35 events, all reconstructed: 26 HIGH / 9 MEDIUM confidence; no Stage 0 event is primary-source). The record partitions into 1 DEFERRED + 2 BACKFILL_GAP + 4 notVerified, and that partition is preserved below. (A) SUBSTANTIVE DEFERRAL — exactly 1, the only DEFERRED event in Stage 0. Item: credit-note edit inventory rewrite. Provenance: seq 32, EV-e174e65a8593d391, actor claude-advisor, HIGH confidence, source 'Stage 0 final report'. Recorded reason, quoted not re-derived: 'the onEdited handler is invoked but always short-circuits on !isOpen because the edit payload omits openedAt and the usage columns (upstream 76fc32078). Fixing it changes edit semantics, which is Stage 1 work.' Status is DEFERRED, not fixed and not absent: the handler is proven unreachable and PINNED by packages/server/test/stage0-final-atomicity.stage0-spec.ts, which asserts expect(seen.openedAt).toBeNull() and expect(seen.isOpen).toBe(false) at lines 248-249 — it pins the short-circuit, it does not assert the rewrite executes. Successor: TASK-0001 'Fix Credit Note inventory edit' (risk=high) exists and is in state ESCALATED; lastError = independent reviewer unavailable, no `codex` executable on the host or in the bc-node container, reviewer-provider independence is a hard policy. The deferral is therefore still open. (B) EVIDENCE GAPS — exactly 2 BACKFILL_GAP events, both reported as UNRECOVERABLE rather than estimated or dropped. Gap 1: Codex design-review transcript (seq 3, EV-c6e945908dc32a4a, HIGH, source 'absence of any stored Codex transcript'). Recorded reason: Stage 0 predates the observatory; Codex reviews were relayed by the human as prose and the verbatim reviewer output was never captured, so it cannot be reconstructed without inventing it. Gap 2: reviewer miss rate / finding-precision denominators (seq 33, EV-5fe39a3dfaf562b2, HIGH, source 'structural limitation of the dataset'). Recorded reason: only findings that were raised are recoverable; issues nobody raised leave no trace, so precision and recall cannot be computed from Stage 0 at all. Accordingly no reviewer-accuracy figure is given — Stage 0 is also SAMPLE SIZE: 1 TASK. (C) NOT VERIFIED BY STAGE 0 ACCEPTANCE — exactly 4, recorded inside RUNTIME_EVIDENCE seq 31 (EV-ca309609e2241c73, tier=final, ok=true, HIGH, source: mysql.general_log trace from stage0-payment-ar-thread.stage0-spec.ts). Note: the design brief cited this event as EV-...; the log's actual eventId at seq 31 is EV-ca309609e2241c73. The four: (1) numeric tax / FX / rounding correctness; (2) historical production data; (3) asynchronous COGS worker behaviour; (4) credit-note edit inventory rewrite — handler proven unreachable, not fixed (the same item as (A), recorded in both places). (D) BOUNDING WHAT 'DEFERRED' EXCLUDES. The four Codex blockers CDX-S0-01..04 were each adjudicated CONFIRMED at seq 20/23/26/29 and fixed (ledger storage-failure propagation, managed Knex transactions in tenancy, financial reversals kept inside the owning transaction, payment-received receivable creation kept inside the transaction). These are CLOSED, not deferred. Stage 0 ended at VERDICT ACCEPTED (seq 34, 'approved as the Stage 0 baseline; not merged') and READY_TO_MERGE (seq 35, branch fix/stage0-ledger-failure-propagation, head 0c6c8735, autoMerge disabled as a HIGH-risk accounting task). Separately, the Stage 0 design declared 13 areas out of scope (tax correctness, FX/exchange-rate correctness, document totals, overapplication rules, period locking, READ_UNCOMMITTED isolation, assertBalanced(), retries/backoff, async COGS worker, pre-COMMIT enqueue, EE/ee packaging, SMTP and invites, NaN route params). Those record what Stage 0 declined to touch; whether that list is complete for Stage 1 planning is itself unverified. (E) EVIDENCE CAVEAT. The quoted runtime figures — Stage 0 suite 29 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped, and Stage -1 canonical baseline 55 clean / 0 regressions / 0 review-required — are read from the recorded RUNTIME_EVIDENCE event and were NOT re-executed in this task; no test run was required or performed, and asserting a green suite without running it would be fabricated evidence. Pre-task and post-task working-tree content digest over tracked AND untracked non-ignored paths outside .ai/ (git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -- ':!.ai' | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum | sha256sum) both = 9521d322d2ba9b097db9ba6dd7f17da2eb4e8e2de3ba03e54fcd416a77c43101 — identical, so no same-path content rewrite, no reverted pre-existing modification, no deletion. git rev-parse HEAD^{tree} = 3ab8a2e2ecaa6986162d729c010bf7377f9b53b2 before and after, establishing that HEAD is unchanged and no commit was created (not cited as working-tree content evidence). git diff HEAD -- ':!.ai' empty before and after. git stash list empty before and after. The set of untracked non-ignored paths outside .ai/ is unchanged (empty both times) and its contents are covered by the digest. Baseline note: the pre-task tree outside .ai/ was already clean, so byte-identity is proven against a clean real starting state. Event-log integrity: .ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl remains 35 lines with 35 unique eventIds and reports no modification under git status. Falsifiable predictions all held: DEFERRED count = 1, BACKFILL_GAP count = 2, the pinning test asserts the short-circuit, and TASK-0001 is ESCALATED on reviewer unavailability — so this summary is not stale.
